findings.title: Site passes core security, DNS, and SEO checks
findings.explanation: The site responds quickly, uses a valid TLS certificate with 150 days left, has all common security headers present (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), has SPF and DMARC email protection records configured, and basic SEO items (title, meta description, canonical, robots.txt, sitemap.xml) are all in place. No issues were found during this audit.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Continue periodic monitoring of TLS expiry and header configuration to keep this healthy state.
